subject: Lift-off MAP & Implementation Checkpoints — Aegis Health
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Kumar <ethan.kumar@aegishealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lift-off MAP & Implementation Checkpoints — Aegis Health

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, I’m sharing a lightweight MAP (mutual action plan) to align on milestones and owners so we can lock a go-live window. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm your internal owners for integrations and data access by EOD Thu (so we can schedule technical discovery).
- Approve the proposed provisional go-live week (w/c Sep 13) or suggest alternatives.
- Upload any procurement/PO timeline constraints so we can plan the SOW.

I’ve looped in Sofia (CS lead) and Marcus (Platform eng) to keep this moving. I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff once we have owners.

Attachments: none yet — will share MAP draft once Sofia has it tidy.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Ethan Kumar <ethan.kumar@aegishealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@aegishealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lift-off MAP & Implementation Checkpoints — Aegis Health

Jordan —

Appreciate the recap. Quick answers from ops:

- Integration lead: Priya Sharma (cc’d)
- Data/infra lead: Ethan Kumar (myself)
- Procurement: Legal & Procurement team expects PO within 3–4 weeks after final SOW

We prefer a go-live in mid-September but could aim earlier if the SOW and security items are quick. To keep things moving we need:

1) SOW skeleton + estimated milestones
2) SOC2 + data flow summary (one-pager)

If you send the MAP draft today we’ll review and propose any owner/date tweaks. Also please include any dependencies that typically block go-lives for similar customers (e.g., data mapping, firewall/IP allowlist).

Thanks —
Ethan
Ethan Kumar | Head of Ops, Aegis Health
ethan.kumar@aegishealth.com | +1 212-555-0150
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Kumar <ethan.kumar@aegishealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@aegishealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Draft + Proposed Milestone Owners (Aegis Health)

Ethan / Priya —

Attached is our initial MAP spreadsheet (Aegis_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOW outline (SOW_outline.pdf). I focused this version on the parts we discussed on the call: onboarding milestones, who owns each task, and realistic target windows. Top-level summary:

- Phase 0 (Preparatory): legal/PO, security questionnaire, NDA — target Aug 20
- Phase 1 (Integration): data mapping, allowlist, test ingestion — target Aug 30–Sep 10
- Phase 2 (Pilot): validation + confidence testing with 2 pilot endpoints — target Sep 13–17
- Phase 3 (Go-live): production cutover and 72-hour stability window — target Sep 20–24

Owners (proposed):
- Procurement / PO: Aegis Procurement (Priya)
- Data mapping: Aegis Data Ops (Ethan) + Redwood Eng (Marcus)
- Feature toggles / rollout policy: Redwood CS (Sofia)

Please:
1) Confirm or nominate owners directly in the attached sheet (column: "Aegis Owner").
2) Tell us if the go-live window needs to shift earlier/later.
3) Share the SOC2 evidence link or the right point of contact for security.

I’ve also added a short kickoff agenda in kickoff-agenda.docx. Proposed time for the kickoff: Mon Aug 10, 10:00–10:30 PT — will send a calendar invite when everyone confirms.

Attachments: Aegis_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_outline.pdf (SOW skeleton), kickoff-agenda.docx

Best,
Sofia Ivanova | Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0188
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Kumar <ethan.kumar@aegishealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@aegishealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft + Proposed Milestone Owners (Aegis Health)

Ethan / Priya —

Quick technical notes to add to the MAP (also captured in the spreadsheet):

- Dev sandbox: Redwood will provision a dedicated non-prod pool. Aegis to provide test dataset (PII redacted) by Aug 18.
- Network: we need a static egress IP range to add to your allowlist; Marcus will send the IPs by EOD 8/4.
- Auth: recommended flow is mutual TLS for ingestion + API key for monitoring.
- KV cache: if latency is a hard SLO for your pilot, we recommend enabling prefix caching (config in MAP tab).

Blocking items that typically push timelines: lack of a test dataset, procurement delays >4 weeks, and internal firewall approval. If any of those are likely, flag them now and we’ll adjust.

I also populated the "Technical Acceptance" checklist in the MAP and added a column for "Completion Criteria" so we have objective gates for each milestone.

DocuSign/SOW: Jordan will share the link after we finalize the SOW outline; Marcus / Eng will review first.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0123
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@aegishealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Kumar <ethan.kumar@aegishealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft + Proposed Milestone Owners (Aegis Health)

Sofia / Marcus —

Thanks for the MAP — we reviewed internally and made a few small edits in your sheet (added Priya -> Procurement owner, adjusted PO target to Aug 28).

A couple of clarifications:
- We will deliver a redacted test dataset by Aug 17 (Ethan will own).
- Firewall allowlist window: procurement usually needs 3 business days once IPs are submitted.
- Pilot scope: we want 2 endpoints (claims processing + patient-notification) included in the pilot — please confirm config limits.

Proposed kickoff: Mon Aug 10, 10:00–10:30 PT — that works for our Ops team.

On Wed, Aug 3, 2026 at 08:45 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Attached is our initial MAP spreadsheet (Aegis_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOW outline (SOW_outline.pdf). I focused this version on the parts we discussed on the call: onboarding milestones, who owns each task, and realistic target windows.

I will mark the MAP as "owner-confirmed" once Ethan and I have the dataset delivery date in the sheet. Please send the IP allowlist details (Marcus) so procurement can start the ticket.

Best,
Priya Sharma | Procurement Lead, Aegis Health
priya.sharma@aegishealth.com | +1 212-555-0180

Date: 2026-08-04T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft + Proposed Milestone Owners (Aegis Health)

Thanks all — confirmed for Aug 10 kickoff (calendar invite sent). Quick next steps from Redwood:

- Marcus to share static egress IPs (EOD 8/04) — actioned.
- Aegis to upload redacted test dataset to our secure S3 link by 8/17 (Ethan).
- Jordan to push SOW skeleton to DocuSign for internal review (target 8/06).

I’ve updated the MAP to reflect the changes Priya mentioned and saved a copy with a timestamp (Aegis_MAP_v1.xlsx -> Aegis_MAP_v1_v2.xlsx). See attachments in the invite.

See you on Mon for kickoff — agenda: introductions, milestone review, open blockers (15m), next three action items (10m), calendar for fortnightly check-ins (5m).

Cheers,
Sofia
